minutes.headline: Committee approved the capital plan as proposed, then voted on the quarterly report, line-item transfers and Esser update.
minutes.summary: The School Committee approved the capital plan as presented, with prioritization deferred to the next meeting, and heard the first FY24 quarterly budget report listing deficit lines, mostly from an unbudgeted private special education tuition. It approved the line item transfers, the Esser update, the strategy for continuous improvement, school improvement plans and committee goals, then went into executive session.

budget_items.topic: Safety window film at Turkey Hill
budget_items.what_was_said: Applying film only to corridor and entry window walls would save a sum and stay above the capital threshold.
Deficit line; this amount is expected to be the ongoing cost of a fully funded summer program.
Salary not budgeted in the general fund but placed in the special education grant as a placeholder; will be transferred against the grant.
Dues were charged to the wrong account; a small transfer addresses it.
Annual subscription increase created a small deficit, addressed separately from transfers.
Deficit because an open speech-language position is being contracted out; funded from that position's salary.
A new private-tuition student arrived over the summer; the tuition is not covered by tonight's transfers and will be addressed during the year.
Fuel account depleted after filling the high school; Turkey Hill still to be filled.
Small deficit for service on a telephone system.
Deficit tied to email archiving required under public records law.
Deficit from golf and cross country uniforms.
A member said the district got no earmarks and a small Chapter 70 increase, and no state mechanism recovers unplanned special education costs.
All funds spent apart from a small balance to be drawn down; final report to state.
Projected deficit if tutors work full hours; hours may be reduced, fringe surplus may cover part.
Nine percent of grant-paid instructional salaries is charged to MTRS for retirement; one employee's health insurance stops after June 30, 2024.
The PTO will give each school a grant for experiential learning.

transfers.description: Negative balance in high school summer guidance scheduling to be addressed by transfer
Schedule B transfers for speech-language pathologist and special services, moving funds to contracted services

decisions.decision: Submit the capital plan as presented now, and take up prioritization at a later meeting; presentation to the capital planning committee to be delayed until after October 18 and timed with the new facilities director.
Window safety film at Turkey Hill to be split into separate sections while staying above the capital threshold.
The chair and superintendent will arrange a presentation on the committee's warrant article for the finance committee hearing next Thursday.
Line item transfers delayed until after the quarterly report, since the two are linked.
Mr Scumbrini will lead the committee's participation in Trunk or Treat on October 28.
Capital plan prioritization is a topic for the next meeting.

not_audible: Mr Leighton's roll call answer on the capital plan vote was not clearly captioned.
Several transfer amounts and the transportation cost for the new tuition student were not given.

what_happened.line: The School Committee approved the capital plan as presented on a roll call, and put the ranking of projects off to a later meeting.
It approved the first FY24 quarterly budget report 4-0 on roll call; the report listed deficit lines, one tied to a new private special education tuition student.
It approved the line item transfers 4-0 on roll call, after delaying them until the quarterly report was heard.
It approved the Esser update, the strategy for continuous improvement and the committee goals, then went into executive session.
The new private tuition student's cost is not covered by these transfers and is to be addressed later in the year.

why_it_matters: Out-of-district tuition is a cost the transfers did not cover, so it may return as a further transfer request or a budget pressure later in FY24.
The capital plan was approved without a ranking of projects, so which school building work comes first is still undecided.
watch_next: Capital plan prioritization is a topic for the next School Committee meeting, with the presentation to the capital planning committee set for after October 18.
The committee's warrant article presentation at the finance committee hearing the following Thursday.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on all nine non-procedural votes and their outcomes, the warrant total, the PTO grant figure and most decisions. The main differences are the $125,000 vs $125,800 tuition figure, who is to present at the Finance Committee hearing, and the official minutes' omission of the line-by-line transfers and most budget figures.
